name: Solo Fabrications

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single commercial building with a light metal roof on a narrow lot along a multi-lane public road|A gravel and dirt yard extends behind the building|A smaller detached structure with a metal roof sits at the rear of the lot|A dirt drive runs along one side of the parcel|Neighboring storage buildings and open yards occupy adjacent properties.

alpha.desc: The front of the building faces S Pacific Ave with a sidewalk and a white metal structure|A roll-up door and a pedestrian door are visible on the street elevation|A sign is mounted on the front wall|A fence separates the dirt road from the area behind the main building|The fence has a gate sufficient for auto traffic|A gravel area sits beside the building|The multi-lane public road runs along the frontage.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows the white metal walls, the street frontage, and the gravel yard behind the structure|A dirt drive runs along the outer edge with a fence separating it from the yard|A smaller detached metal-roof structure sits at the rear|Dry open ground and neighboring lots continue beyond the parcel.

charlie.desc: The rear of the lot shows the back of the white metal building, a gravel and dirt yard, and a smaller detached metal-roof structure|A dirt drive runs along one side|A fence and a blue wall from a neighboring building sit along either edge of the yard|The public road remains visible at the front of the site.

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows the white metal walls, a sign on the street elevation, and a gravel yard extending to the rear|A neighboring blue wall runs along the lot's opposite edge|A smaller detached metal-roof structure sits at the back of the yard|The public road and sidewalk run along the frontage.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from S Pacific Ave into a gravel area at the front and from a dirt drive along the side of the lot. The site is a small commercial shop building on a narrow parcel next to a multi-lane highway. Circulation space is limited beside the building and more open in the rear yard. Neighboring storage buildings, commercial lots, and a large parking lot sit across the highway. No paved fire lane is visible on the parcel.
clarifications: Is the roll-up door the primary shop entrance, or is the pedestrian door the public entry? Does the dirt drive continue to another public street, or does it end on the parcel? Are there any gates across the side drive or rear yard? Is vehicle access available behind the main building? What is the use of the smaller detached structure at the rear? Is after-hours access controlled by a lock or code?
